Chaque virement et chaque empannage donn: Each tack and each gybe gives a reading of the local wind, without exception. A symmetric manoeuvre, entering and exiting at the same angle to the wind, puts its midpoint on the wind axis and gives a true reading; entering on a reach to come out upwind shifts that midpoint by the same amount. This bias cannot be corrected manoeuvre by manoeuvre, but it changes sign from one manoeuvre to the next: the most symmetric manoeuvres weigh more in the average and the standard deviation, and the whole evens out. Between two manoeuvres the curve is interpolated; before the first and after the last, it keeps the nearest value. It breaks off after more than 30 minutes without a manoeuvre. On the chart, the dots mark the manoeuvres: that is where, and only where, the wind is measured. The chart keeps the same zoom as the speed chart. {zoomText}
